(pdf) – will be available on the 1st day of class. Complete this form to request approval to audit a course. Steps to audit a course: Use Course Lookup and check to see if the course is still available. Obtain email approval from the instructor via their UTD email. Be sure to include the term, course prefix, number and section of the class that you are requesting to audit.
